note.en: TODO verify: only the names, year levels and start years are published. As at 2026-09-29 the Ministry has NOT published the number of subjects, the pass rule, the grading scale, or the assessment split - its own update puts these in 'Tranche 2, still being developed'. The project spec suggested '>=5 subjects, pass >=3, A+ to E with C a pass'; those numbers are NOT in any official source found, so they are recorded as null with status tbc rather than copied in. Do not fill them from the spec.
note.zh: 待核实：官方目前只公布了名称、对应年级与起始年份。截至 2026-09-29，教育部**尚未公布**科目数量、通过规则、评分标尺与评估构成——其更新说明称这些属于「Tranche 2，仍在制定」。项目规格提出的「每年 ≥5 门、通过 ≥3 门、A+–E 且 C 及以上通过」在已查到的官方来源中**均无出处**，因此记为 null + status tbc，不予照抄。
